note: Look-lock keyframes for Ivan's room (scene s03). Each is one fixed camera next to the reference it must reach. tools/keyframes.mjs renders them and builds the side-by-side sheet with numbers.

frames.name: Window wall at 3 AM
frames.take: light hierarchy: lamp pool on the left wall, blue screens, the window as a bright, framed city; deep but soft blacks; warm overall

frames.name: Ivan at the desk
frames.take: night desk: the monitor is the cool key on the face and desk, one small warm lamp behind, the room readable in deep blue, never black

frames.name: Lamp corner and bed
frames.take: a floor lamp soft warm pool on the wall and soft bedding, cool window light on the other side, clean plump fabrics, soft graded shadows

frames.name: Top-down
frames.take: layout, readable objects, light pools seen from above (the reference is daylight; we match layout and readability, not the sun)

frames.name: Door side
frames.take: the quiet side of a night room: soft cool ambient from the window, walls and furniture readable in low light, clean matte surfaces, no hard light patches

frames.name: Wide from the door corner
frames.take: warm practicals fill the room evenly; walls readable mid-tones; soft falloff into one dark corner

frames.name: Lamp corner, close
frames.take: one warm patterned lamp, soft shadow gradients on a textured wall, plant silhouettes

frames.name: Bed wall, frontal
frames.take: frontal wall composition: warm lamp + cool window edge, framed prints, rug grounding the furniture

frames.name: Night wide, desk side
frames.take: blue night ambient everywhere, monitor glow as the accent, one small warm lamp, nothing pure black

frames.name: Lamp and bed
frames.take: warm lamp pool on wall and soft plump bedding, cool window light opposite

frames.name: Door side
frames.take: quiet dark side: clean matte furniture, soft cool fill from the window, readable shapes

frames.name: Wide from the desk corner
frames.take: dark room held together by several small warm pools, teal window, rug, depth in layers

frames.name: Window wall from the door
frames.take: blue moonlit window as the brightest shape, soft blue spill on the floor, deep blue shadows

frames.name: Hero: window wall
frames.take: frontal and centred: the window the brightest shape (soft city bokeh), monitors the cool accent, one amber lamp left, bookshelf and guitar right, dark green walls, a soft foreground

frames.name: Hero: reverse from the desk
frames.take: layered depth: blurred laptop and desk in front, the chair as a dark silhouette, the story wall behind (door with hoodie, poster, corkboard, console with LEDs, wardrobe), one amber lamp at the side, small coloured LED accents
